# The Gospel of John · Book Overview (KJV)
> Unit john-00 · John 1–21 · loop john-kjv-study v2.0 · DRAFT for human doctrine review

## 🧭 At a Glance
### 🧵 Golden Thread
John writes so that we might believe that Jesus is the Christ and have life through his name.

### 🌗 Life & Light Frame
John speaks into a world that sits in death, and Christ gives life. John exposes the darkness men love, and Christ gives the light of life.

### 🎯 Course Outcomes
- Trace the signs and the sayings of Jesus through the book.
- Explain why John wrote, from John 20:31.
- **Doing:** Carry life and light to one named person in each lesson.

### 📋 Life & Light At-a-Glance
| | What is dead or dark | Where the source is, with verse | What I do about it today |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Life** | A world without life | Jesus, who gives life (John 10:10) | Believe and receive |
| **Light** | Darkness men love | Jesus, the light of the world (John 8:12) | Come to the light |

### 🗂️ Passage Map
| Section | Verses | Theme | One-Line Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prologue | John 1:1–18 | The Word made flesh | The Word who was God becomes flesh. |
| The Book of Signs | John 1:19–12:50 | Signs and sayings | Jesus reveals himself to Israel. |
| The Farewell | John 13:1–17:26 | Love and the Spirit | Jesus prepares his disciples. |
| The Passion and Resurrection | John 18:1–20:31 | The hour of glory | Jesus dies and rises. |
| Epilogue | John 21:1–25 | Restored and sent | Peter is restored. |

## 🏛️ Core Foundations
### ✝️ Christological Root
**Gospel Foundation:** "But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name." (John 20:31)

**The Bridge:** The whole book exists to bring men to believing life.

**Canonical Echoes:** Jesus (John 20:31) → Promise (Isaiah 9:2) → Doctrine (Romans 10:9) → Life (1 John 5:13)

**What Gets Lost:** Without this root, John becomes a book of ideas.

### ⚔️ Spiritual Warfare
**The Lie:** Jesus is only a teacher.

**The Truth:** He is the Son of God (John 20:31).

**The Battleground:** The mind that will not believe.

**The Weapon:** The written witness.

### 🌱 Life Pathway
**The Theft:** Death reigns where the Son is not received.

**The Source:** Jesus, the life (John 14:6).

**The Channel:** Witnesses who tell what they have seen.

**The Abundance Guard:** Abundant life is fullness of life in Christ, not money or ease.

### 💡 Light Pathway
**The Darkness:** Men love darkness.

**The Source:** The light of the world (John 8:12).

**The Lamp:** The testimony of the beloved disciple.

**The Love Guard:** Light without love is glare.

## 🟢 Tier 1 — Easy
### 📌 Core Concept
John tells us about Jesus so that we will trust him and live.

### 📖 Key Verses
"And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth." (John 1:14)

"For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life." (John 3:16)

"But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name." (John 20:31)

### 🪞 Analogy
John's Gospel is like a guided tour of a great house, with the owner as the guide.

### 🔎 Diagnostic Check
- Do I believe that Jesus is the Son of God?
- Do I read John to meet Jesus?
- Do I love the light or the dark?
- Do I tell others what I have seen?

### ✅ Action Step
Read one chapter of John each day this week.

### 🌗 Life and Light, Simply
Jesus gives life that never ends. Jesus shows us the way like a light in the dark.

## 🟡 Tier 2 — Medium
### 🏺 Setting the Scene
The church has received the Gospel as the testimony of the beloved disciple, traditionally John the son of Zebedee.

### 📚 Chapter-by-Chapter Breakdown
#### John 1 · The Word Made Flesh
John writes "the Word was made flesh" (John 1:14), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 2 · The First Sign
John writes "manifested forth his glory" (John 2:11), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 3 · Ye Must Be Born Again
John writes "God so loved the world" (John 3:16), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 4 · Living Water
John writes "a well of water springing up into everlasting life" (John 4:14), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 5 · The Son Who Gives Life
John writes "is passed from death unto life" (John 5:24), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 6 · The Bread of Life
John writes "I am the bread of life" (John 6:35), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 7 · Rivers of Living Water
John writes "let him come unto me, and drink" (John 7:37), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 8 · The Light of the World
John writes "I am the light of the world" (John 8:12), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 9 · Once Blind, Now Seeing
John writes "whereas I was blind, now I see" (John 9:25), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 10 · The Good Shepherd
John writes "I am the good shepherd" (John 10:11), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 11 · The Resurrection and the Life
John writes "I am the resurrection, and the life" (John 11:25), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 12 · The Hour Is Come
John writes "will draw all men unto me" (John 12:32), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 13 · Having Loved His Own
John writes "love one another" (John 13:34), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 14 · The Way, the Truth, and the Life
John writes "I am the way, the truth, and the life" (John 14:6), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 15 · Abide in Me
John writes "I am the vine, ye are the branches" (John 15:5), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 16 · Sorrow Turned into Joy
John writes "I have overcome the world" (John 16:33), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 17 · The High Priestly Prayer
John writes "this is life eternal" (John 17:3), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 18 · Whom Seek Ye
John writes "bear witness unto the truth" (John 18:37), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 19 · It Is Finished
John writes "It is finished" (John 19:30), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 20 · That Ye Might Believe
John writes "that believing ye might have life through his name" (John 20:31), and the chapter builds on it.

#### John 21 · Lovest Thou Me
John writes "Feed my sheep" (John 21:17), and the chapter builds on it.

### 🚫 Common Errors Quick-Reference
| Error | Why it is wrong | The correction, with verse |
|---|---|---|
| Jesus was only a teacher | John presents the Word who was God | John 1:1 |
| Signs are the goal | Signs point to belief in him | John 20:31 |

### 🧨 Cultural Landmines and Misconceptions
The Jews in John are not a race to be blamed; the term often means the leaders in Judea.

## 🔴 Tier 3 — Expert
### 🏗️ Theological Framework
John is the Gospel of the incarnate Word.

### 📚 Scholarly Insights
Augustine, *Tractates on the Gospel of John*, reads the book as the gospel of the Word (verify).

### ⚔️ Debate Corner
Some date John early, others late; the Reformed reading does not depend on the date.

**Pastoral Warning:** Don't let dating debates distract a church from the witness.

### 🔤 Original Language Deep Dive
The verb *pisteusēte* (G4100, John 20:31, V-AAS-2P) carries the purpose of the book.

### 🚷 Preaching Mistakes to Avoid
- **Information without life:** teaching the outline without the Lord.
- **Heat without light:** passion without the text.
- Allegory: reading symbols into every detail.

## 🟣 Tier 4 — Christocentric, Humility, Life & Light
### 👑 Every Answer in Jesus
In him are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge (Colossians 2:3).

### 🙇 Humility Practices
- Pray the publican's prayer each morning (Luke 18:13).
- Learn of the meek and lowly Lord today (Matthew 11:29).
- Let the mind of Christ govern your service (Philippians 2:5).

### 🌱 Life Practices
- **Inward:** Receive his word before you speak (John 15:5).
- **Outward:** Speak life to one tired friend (Proverbs 18:21).
- **Outward:** Share bread with the hungry (John 6:35).

### 💡 Light Practices
- **Inward:** Confess one hidden sin today (John 3:21).
- **Outward:** Open Scripture with someone in the dark (Psalm 119:105).
- **Outward:** Do good so that the Father is glorified (Matthew 5:16).

## 📚 Doctrine
### Theology Proper · The Father Sends the Son
**Proposition:** The Father Sends the Son.

**Textual Anchor:** John writes "God so loved the world" (John 3:16).

**Cross-References:** "No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him." (John 1:18); "And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent." (John 17:3)

**Errors Refuted:** This refutes the error that Jesus was only a good teacher.

**Pastoral Fruit:** It humbles us and moves us to worship.

### Christology · The Word Is God Made Flesh
**Proposition:** The Word Is God Made Flesh.

**Textual Anchor:** John writes "the Word was made flesh" (John 1:14).

**Cross-References:** "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." (John 1:1); "For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily." (Colossians 2:9)

**Errors Refuted:** This refutes the error that Jesus was only a good teacher.

**Pastoral Fruit:** It humbles us and moves us to worship.

### Pneumatology · The Spirit Gives Life
**Proposition:** The Spirit Gives Life.

**Textual Anchor:** John writes "It is the spirit that quickeneth" (John 6:63).

**Cross-References:** "Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God." (John 3:5); "But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you." (Romans 8:11)

**Errors Refuted:** This refutes the error that Jesus was only a good teacher.

**Pastoral Fruit:** It humbles us and moves us to worship.

### Anthropology & Sin · Men Love Darkness
**Proposition:** Men Love Darkness.

**Textual Anchor:** John writes "men loved darkness rather than light" (John 3:19).

**Cross-References:** "The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?" (Jeremiah 17:9); "For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;" (Romans 3:23)

**Errors Refuted:** This refutes the error that Jesus was only a good teacher.

**Pastoral Fruit:** It humbles us and moves us to worship.

### Soteriology & Grace · Life Through Believing
**Proposition:** Life Through Believing.

**Textual Anchor:** John writes "that believing ye might have life through his name" (John 20:31).

**Cross-References:** "For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:" (Ephesians 2:8); "Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life." (John 5:24)

**Errors Refuted:** This refutes the error that Jesus was only a good teacher.

**Pastoral Fruit:** It humbles us and moves us to worship.

### Assumed Here
- **Ecclesiology:** John assumes the flock the Shepherd gathers (John 10:16).
- **Eschatology:** John assumes the last day (John 6:40).
- **Christian Walk:** John assumes a life of abiding (John 15:4).

## ⚖️ The Council's Hard Questions
### ❓ Question 1 · Who Wrote John?
**Moderator:** What can we say about the author?

**Historian:** The church received it from the beloved disciple.

**Church Historian:** The early church named John the son of Zebedee.

**Resolution:** The text names the beloved disciple as its witness (John 21:24).

### ❓ Question 2 · How Does John Differ from the Other Gospels?
**Literary Scholar:** John gives long discourses and the Judean ministry.

**Philologist:** His vocabulary is simple and deep.

**Resolution:** The Gospels complement one another (John 20:30).

### ❓ Question 3 · Who Are the Jews in John?
**Theologian:** Often the leaders in Judea who opposed Jesus.

**Pastor:** The book must never feed contempt for Jewish people.

**Teacher:** A group can see that the disciples were Jews too.

**Resolution:** Read the term in context (John 1:11).

### 🔦 The Life & Light Audit
**Pastor:** A reader who obeyed would believe and carry life and light.

**Theologian:** Nothing depends on the reader's own power (John 15:5).

**Teacher:** A beginner could do it.

**Fix:** None was needed.

## 🗝️ Leader's Guide
### ❓ Teacher FAQ
- **What if a student uses a different Bible version?** Read the KJV aloud together and gloss the old words.
- **What if someone misunderstands a doctrine?** Return to the text and ask what it says.
- **What if we don't finish all five levels?** Take the Life and Light levels first.
- **What if someone reads abundant life as money?** Read the Abundance Guard aloud (John 10:10).
- **What if someone uses the light on others?** Turn to the Light Planner's first row.
- **What if someone has no one to name?** Start with the household.

### 🛠️ Advanced Teacher Hacks
- Silent processing: wait seven to ten seconds.
- Group engagement: read the verse aloud together.
- The cross-reference hack: keep extra verses in reserve.
- The application trick: close with the I will lines.
- The doctrinal anchor: move from story to truth.
- Humbling and exalting: use the Humility Practices.
- Bring life: run the naming round out loud.
- Bring light: the leader goes first on the inward row.

### 🐑 Shepherding Notes
Some members carry grief; the resurrection chapters need care.

### 🎯 Teaching Angles
**For a Tier 1 Group:** Follow the signs one by one.

**For a Tier 2 Group:** Trace the I am sayings.

**Tough Question 1:** Why is John so different? It was written for a purpose (John 20:31).

**Tough Question 2:** Is Jesus God in John? Yes (John 1:1).

**Tough Question 3:** Why do some verses appear in brackets in other editions? Teach the KJV text and explain calmly.

### 🌀 Going Deeper
For life, read Romans 8:1–11. For light, read 1 John 1:5–7. For sound doctrine, read Titus 2:1.
